name: Silk Unsweetened Plain Almond Milk (Ultra-Filtered)
whyItWorks: Finely ground blanched almonds filtered through micro-mesh, removing all solid particles and hulls. It is 100% dairy-free, lactose-free, low-calorie, and fortified with 50% more calcium than dairy milk without any digestive friction.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Shake carton well before pouring. Excellent base for smoothies or morning cereal.
watchOuts: Low in protein (1g per cup); combine with eggs or poultry if seeking protein density.
